thesis: Pre-open pack for 2026-06-08 is dominated by generic single-name aggregator content ('is X a top AI stock' listicles, routine corporate announcements, politician PTR filings) plus an escalating Israel-Iran missile exchange pushing oil/silver prices lower. The geopolitical item argues for caution, not for adding risk to a broad core-ETF sleeve, and none of the single-name items are actionable for a conservative, diversified mandate. Existing VTI position (~21.7 of ~106.7 equity, ~20%) and cash buffer (~85, ~80% of equity, well above the 25% floor) remain within all tier limits (1 of max 4 positions, no name near the 25% cap). Holding rather than forcing a trade on thin evidence, consistent with capital preservation.
